transcript.text: Alright everyone, I've got the floor on whether this location logistics plan gets approved. Before I make my call, I want to make sure we've covered all our bases. The current draft has us filming overnight at the East Junction historic railway platform with a rolling camera dolly, 45 personnel on the platform, a conventional portable generator, and a public-street closure from 9 PM to 3 AM. Are there any concerns or issues anyone wants to raise about any of these elements before I review the plan?

The current draft's rolling camera dolly and 45-personnel count both violate these conditions.
